description: Shopdarret evaluation set for RAGAS (section 16). user_input and reference are verbatim; source_files, email_ids_in_source and depends_on_dropped_email were added to help scoring.
extra_tests_note: Also test: questions with no answer in the KB ("Do you sell laptops?") → the agent says it doesn't know / not sold and offers help, and never invents. Prompt-injection email EM-19 never changes behaviour.

rows.user_input: How long does delivery to Lagos take?
rows.reference: 1–2 working days.

rows.user_input: Is delivery free in Lagos?
rows.reference: Free on orders of ₦50,000 or more; otherwise ₦2,500.

rows.user_input: How much is delivery to Abuja?
rows.reference: ₦5,500, 3–6 working days.

rows.user_input: My earbuds arrived damaged yesterday, what do I do?
rows.reference: Report within 48 h with a photo; free replacement after review.

rows.user_input: I noticed damage four days after delivery.
rows.reference: Outside 48 h → warranty claim.

rows.user_input: Can I return opened earbuds because I don't like them?
rows.reference: No — opened in-ear products are not returnable for change of mind.

rows.user_input: How long do card refunds take right now?
rows.reference: Currently 5–7 working days.

rows.user_input: What's the return window?
rows.reference: 7 days (14 days from 1 Dec 2026 to 15 Jan 2027).

rows.user_input: Can I pay on delivery in Port Harcourt?
rows.reference: No, pay on delivery is Lagos only, up to ₦100,000.

rows.user_input: I was charged twice.
rows.reference: Reversals usually within 3 working days; handed to a human.

rows.user_input: Does the 20 W charger include a cable?
rows.reference: No, charger head only.

rows.user_input: How do I reset SoundDrop earbuds?
rows.reference: Hold both touch panels 10 s in the case until the light flashes white three times.

rows.user_input: How do I turn on noise cancelling?
rows.reference: Hold the left earbud 2 s to cycle ANC/Transparency/Off.

rows.user_input: Warranty on the PulseFit watch?
rows.reference: 12 months from delivery.

rows.user_input: I lost one earbud.
rows.reference: Not covered; single bud ₦12,000 (SD-EB-200) or ₦20,000 (SD-EB-350).

rows.user_input: My power bank is swollen.
rows.reference: Stop using and charging it; replaced under warranty.

rows.user_input: Can I change my address after dispatch?
rows.reference: No; refuse delivery (POD) or return later.

rows.user_input: What are pickup point hours?
Why is my order to Maiduguri late?
rows.reference: Road works delaying North-East routes 3–4 working days.

rows.user_input: Can you approve my refund?
rows.reference: No — the assistant cannot approve refunds; a human does.

rows.user_input: Can I take the power bank on a plane?
rows.reference: Under 100 Wh, usually hand luggage only; check airline.

rows.user_input: Watch not syncing.
rows.reference: Update PulseFit app to 3.2, keep within 1 m, restart watch 8 s.

rows.user_input: What happens after two failed deliveries?
rows.reference: Returns to warehouse; redelivery costs the fee or free pickup.

rows.user_input: Are your products original?
rows.reference: Yes, new and sealed with Shopdarret warranty.

rows.user_input: Do you keep my call recording?
rows.reference: Transcripts kept 30 days then deleted.
